description: Create an outbound call campaign (cadence + lead batch) and optionally launch it immediately. Launching queues calls for the orchestrator; existing TCPA/consent gating still applies at dial time. Requires admin role on the business.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to place the calls. Required when launch is true.

business_id.description: Business ID (required only when the token can access multiple businesses).

cadence_config.description: Cadence configuration. { template: standard|aggressive|nurture|custom, attempts: number }.

launch.description: When true, launch the campaign immediately after creating it.

lead_ids.description: Lead IDs to enroll in the campaign (optional at create time).

lead_variables.description: Each customer's values for the script's blanks, keyed by lead ID: { "<lead_id>": { "last_year_items": "tables and chairs" } }. "name" is filled from the lead when it has one.

script.description: What Kai says on these calls. Write blanks as {{ snake_case }}, e.g. "Hi, is this {{ name }}? You rented {{ last_year_items }} from us last year." A blank needs a value for every customer (lead_variables) or a default: {{ name | default: "there" }}. Launch is refused if any customer is missing a value. The script is added to the agent's saved instructions for these calls only; it does not change the agent.

instructions.description: Why Kai is calling and what to do when the customer says yes, wants to think about it, says no, or asks not to be called.

rules.description: Hard rules for these calls, e.g. "Never quote prices."

voicemail.description: What Kai leaves on an answering machine.

name: create_campaign
title: Create Campaign
